key_idea: Use current graphs with group-element labels to lift small, manageable quotient embeddings into symmetric triangulations of complete graphs via covering spaces.
reason: Although the invention of current graphs is a surprising and brilliant conceptual leap, it is heavily buried under a massive, book-length construction split into twelve cases with sporadic exceptions. The extreme intricacy and combinatorial bookkeeping required to piece the embeddings together obscure any sense of inevitability.
